title: Run matches in the arena
lead: `pit run a.s b.s --seed N`: in `internal/arena`, assemble the bots, place them with the in-repo seeded PRNG, schedule round-robin, stop at the cycle limit, and print a text result.
boundary: **Not in this slice:** writing replay files, tournaments, viewers.

sections.heading: Why
sections.body: Milestone 4 and goals 3-4. Every later feature runs matches through this.

sections.heading: Files
sections.body:
- `internal/arena/rng.go`: the PRNG from `docs/spec/match.md` (C36), not math/rand.
- `internal/arena/config.go`: match config with the spec defaults.
- `internal/arena/place.go`: seeded non-overlapping placement.
- `internal/arena/match.go`: the match loop over `internal/vm`, returning a result value and the VM events.
- `internal/arena/rng_test.go`, `place_test.go`, `match_test.go`.
- `internal/arena/testdata/`: small hand-written bots for the tests and the CLI check (for example `sitter.s`, which loops forever, and `suicide.s`, which dies on its first instruction).
- `cmd/pit/run.go`: the `run` subcommand; `cmd/pit/run_test.go`.

sections.heading: Failing tests
sections.body:
- `TestRNGVectors`: the PRNG reproduces the spec's test vectors for each listed seed.
- `TestPlacement`: table-driven over the spec's worked examples; positions match, are non-overlapping and honor min separation.
- `TestPlacementImpossible`: the spec's impossible config returns the spec's error.
- `TestTurnOrder`: two hand-built bots execute in the spec's order (checked through the returned events).
- `TestCycleLimit`: two `sitter` bots stop at the cycle limit and both are reported as survivors.
- `TestResults`: the tie rule, a single winner (`sitter` vs `suicide`), and a dead bot each produce the spec's result.
- `TestDeterministic`: the same bots, seed and config run twice give identical results and events.
- `TestRunCommand` (`cmd/pit`): bot files under `t.TempDir()`; running twice prints byte-identical output; a bad bot file prints the assembler's positioned error and exits non-zero.

sections.heading: Implement
sections.body:
- The arena wraps the pure VM core; arena code that the match loop runs has no maps (C36) and no clock.
- The CLI stays non-interactive and scriptable so the later agent harness can drive it (C09). PROJECT.md does not define a machine-readable output; the implementer decides its form (for example a `--json` flag) and the text format, and records them per C35; the reviewer checks them.
- Config flags beyond `--seed` (core size, cycle limit and so on) are the implementer's call, recorded per C35.

sections.heading: Check
sections.body:
- `. scripts/env.sh && go test ./... && go vet ./... && test -z "$(gofmt -l cmd internal)"` passes.
- `. scripts/env.sh && go run ./cmd/pit run internal/arena/testdata/sitter.s internal/arena/testdata/suicide.s --seed 1 > .cache/tmp/run1.txt && go run ./cmd/pit run internal/arena/testdata/sitter.s internal/arena/testdata/suicide.s --seed 1 > .cache/tmp/run2.txt && cmp .cache/tmp/run1.txt .cache/tmp/run2.txt` succeeds.
- No maps: `grep -rn --include='*.go' --exclude='*_test.go' 'map\[' internal/vm internal/arena` prints nothing; `grep -rn 'math/rand' internal cmd` prints nothing.
- The reviewer checks each C35 decision recorded by this slice.

sections.heading: Git
sections.body: Branch `slice/<id>-arena` in `.worktrees/<id>`. One commit when the owner asks.
